layman_headline: The crypto market is fearful and no swing candidate looks compelling enough to jump in right now.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin is stuck below $65,000 in a fearful market (Fear & Greed at 29). The coins flagged as swing candidates are either post-crash wreckage with no clear bottom (BEAT down 68% in a week), already pumped and overextended (CYS up 253%, VELVET up 63%), stablecoins, or gold-backed tokens that have already run up 8%. Solana is the most interesting large-cap with modest 3.6% weekly gain, but it lacks a clear technical trigger — no RSI, no MACD cross data, and BTC dominance at 56.5% is suppressing alts. Better to wait for a cleaner setup.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market hasn't given a clear buy signal yet. Watch for Bitcoin to either break above $65K convincingly or dip toward the $63K support zone — either could create better alt-coin entries.
expert_reasoning: No swing candidate presents a favorable risk-reward right now. BEAT's 68% crash lacks any bottom-confirmation signal (RSI at 51 is suspiciously neutral for that drop, suggesting structural issues not a bounce setup). CYS and VELVET are classic chase trades — extended 250%+ and 63% respectively with no pullback entry. PAXG/XAUT have already moved 8% on gold strength and offer poor crypto-native upside. SOL is the best positioned blue-chip alt but at $76 and -74% from ATH, it needs BTC to resolve its $63-69K range first. The Fear & Greed improving trend (28.7 → 29) is constructive but not yet actionable. CPI data this week could be the catalyst that breaks the range.
risk_factors: CPI week could trigger a sharp BTC sell-off below $63K, dragging all alts lower
BTC dominance at 56.5% and rising means capital is rotating away from alts
Hormuz geopolitical tensions fading could reduce safe-haven flows but also general crypto interest
watch_list: BTC price action around $63K support and $65K resistance — a break either way sets the alt trade
CPI data release this week — hot print could crush risk assets, cool print could spark rally
SOL RSI and volume — if RSI dips below 35 on a BTC pullback, that's the entry signal
market_context: Crypto is in a fear-dominated consolidation with BTC pinned between $63-65K. High BTC dominance (56.5%) is hostile to alt-coin swing trades, and CPI week adds macro uncertainty.
context_banner: Market in fear-driven consolidation ahead of CPI — no clean swing entry exists among current candidates; patience is the trade.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 29 (Fear) with a slight improving trend from 28.7 weekly avg — not yet enough to signal a contrarian buy.
BTC trapped between $63K on-chain demand zone and $69K holder resistance heading into CPI week — range resolution needed before alt entries.
Sell pressure reportedly nearing exhaustion after $4B USDT market-cap drop, suggesting potential bottoming process but not confirmed.
No volume breakout detected on any quality candidate — CYS and VELVET volume spikes are on already-extended moves with poor risk-reward.
Only BEAT has RSI data (51, neutral) which is inconsistent with its -68% crash, suggesting data quality issues; SOL lacks RSI data entirely.
